title: BoolE: Exact Symbolic Reasoning via Boolean Equality Saturation
problem: Boolean symbolic reasoning on gate-level netlists for verification and synthesis struggles to accurately identify multi-input, multi-output structures (e.g., full adders). Conventional approaches using structural hashing are sensitive to structural modifications from technology mapping and logic optimization.
motivation: Boolean symbolic reasoning is critical for gate-level verification, logic/datapath synthesis, and hardware security; existing methods fail to handle datapath and adder tree reasoning accurately.
method: BoolE explores all equivalent ways to arrange a circuit's basic building blocks (gate-level netlists) using Boolean transformation rules, storing the equivalent forms in a data structure called an e-graph. It then uses an extraction algorithm to recognize when groups of gates form familiar structures like full adders or datapath blocks—even after the circuit has been optimized—making it easier to reason about what the circuit does and improve it.
key_novelty: The key innovation is recognizing high-level circuit patterns (full adders, datapath blocks) from gate-level representations, even when the circuit has been restructured by optimization tools.
contributions: Equality saturation framework with domain-specific Boolean ruleset
Novel extraction algorithm for multi-I/O structure identification
3.53x and 3.01x more exact full adders identified than ABC in carry-save and Booth multipliers
Four orders of magnitude speedup in formal verification integration

metrics.speedup: 3.53-3.01x full adder detection vs ABC; 4+ orders of magnitude in formal verification

primary_theme: Equality saturation for exact Boolean symbolic reasoning with novel multi-I/O structure extraction
